summary: On 2026-08-25 US equities closed with a composite risk score of 44.69 (caution), up +0.13 on the 1-day and +2.74 on the 1-week. The goldilocks regime held: inflation is cooling (CPI 3.30, core 2.47, core PCE 3.29) but the labor market shows cracks (payrolls -23.0). Rates rose: the 10Y yield 4.74 (prior 4.69), the 2Y 4.24, the 10Y real rate 2.4 (prior 2.35), and the 10Y/2Y spread +0.5. Breadth is extremely divided: only 0.65% of names made 52-week highs while 65.16% are above the 200-day MA. Rotation favored AI infrastructure (AI Infrastructure +2.40%, Networking +2.23%, Quantum +1.70%) and semis (Semiconductors +1.92%, Memory +1.27%), while software lagged (AI Software -0.17%, Cybersecurity -1.06%). At the single-stock level AMD led with +4.78%, NVDA +1.88%, MU +1.75%, AVGO -0.73%; the A-share memory chain sold off hard (603986.sh -6.70%, 688825.sh -2.41%). Crypto was flat (BTC 78761, -0.03%). VIX 15.85 (prior 15.13). Nvidia earnings on 2026-08-26 is the binary event.

top_risk_drivers.claim: Restrictive real rates dominate macro risk: the 10Y real rate is 2.4 (97.59 percentile) and the 10Y yield is 4.74, consistent with goldilocks but still elevated and capping valuation.
Extreme breadth divergence: only 0.65% of stocks made 52-week highs while 65.16% trade above the 200-day MA, with price 8.04% above the MA200.
Nvidia earnings on 2026-08-26 is the binary event: semis relative strength is -12.06% and Nvidia gained +1.88% on the day.
Labor market cracks: payrolls fell -23.0 while inflation keeps cooling (CPI 3.30, core PCE 3.29).

supporting_signals.claim: AI-infrastructure and semis rotation is strong: AI Infrastructure +2.40%, Networking +2.23%, Semiconductors +1.27%, Memory +1.27%.
At the single-stock level AMD led with +4.78%, MU +1.75%, TSLA +0.62%.
Credit is stable: high-yield OAS is 2.69 and reverse repo is 0.405 (a liquidity buffer).

contradicting_signals.claim: Volatility is creeping up: VIX 15.85 (prior 15.13) and realized vol 13.28 diverge from the low level.
Cross-asset confirmation is only 0.5 and the A-share memory chain sold off hard (603986.sh -6.70%, 688825.sh -2.41%).

what_changed_today: The 10Y yield rose from 4.69 to 4.74 and the real rate from 2.35 to 2.4.
VIX rose from 15.13 to 15.85, lifting the volatility dimension.
AI Infrastructure +2.40% led while software lagged (AI Software -0.17%, Cybersecurity -1.06%).
The A-share memory chain fell against the trend: 603986.sh -6.70%, 688825.sh -2.41%.
watch_next: 2026-08-26 Nvidia earnings (medium) and core PCE/GDP (high) set the direction for semis and rates.
Watch whether the 0.65% new-high divergence spreads to the 65.16% above the MA200.
Watch reverse repo at 0.405 and the Fed balance sheet at 6745699 for liquidity marginal change.

bull_case.title: Bull case: rates and inflation ease gently
points: If the real rate eases from 2.4, valuation pressure eases.
Inflation keeps cooling (CPI 3.30, core PCE 3.29) and the Fed holds.
Semis relative strength of -12.06% recovers and AI Infrastructure +2.40% continues.

base_case.title: Base case: range-bound caution
points: Risk holds near 44.69 (caution) with a 1-day trend of +0.13.
AI-infra/semis rotation (AI Infrastructure +2.40%, Semiconductors +1.27%) offsets software weakness.
Breadth divergence (0.65% new highs vs 65.16% above MA200) persists but does not spread.

bear_case.title: Bear case: a Nvidia earnings miss triggers de-risking
points: If 2026-08-26 Nvidia earnings land on the downside, semis relative strength of -12.06% worsens.
VIX breaks above 15.85 and the volatility dimension at 26.75 rises.
Breadth divergence spreads, with the 0.65% new-high rate widening into broader selling.
